comparable_base_note: c10-bare-baseline's 14.8813 s at 1350 MHz was measured on 5e1886b4f. The two commits since it only rewrote comment and docstring prose; capture.py checks that as ASTs with docstrings stripped and records the verdict, rather than asserting it.
question: F, the part of the fold that does not scale with AICLK, measured directly by interleaving pinned clock arms inside one process and one device context.
prediction: Identical model configuration in every arm: predicted model-cycle saving exactly zero. This row prices nothing and ships nothing. See prediction.json for the numeric predictions and the refutation criteria, recorded before any fold.

clock.order: alternating: 1350,1200,1000,800 on even reps and the reverse on odd reps, so no arm sits systematically early or late in the session
clock.mechanism: ARC FORCE_AICLK (0x33) through tt-kmd's SMC message queue, re-sent and re-verified before EVERY label, released in the finally block
clock.settle: the requested MHz must appear in sysfs and stay there for 200 ms before the timer starts, within a 5 s timeout
clock.unheld_clock: an arm the chip does not actually hold is rejected, never reported
clock.800_is_an_arm: scripts/aiclk_watch.sh logs AICLK-WATCH: qb2 CLAMPED-UNDER-LOAD for a busy chip under 1200 MHz, so this row trips the fleet's own guard on purpose. A pinned 800 MHz fold is a measurement; an unrequested one is an artifact, and the during-fold sampling plus the board power reading prove which this was.

host_cpu_witness.foreign: any process outside the run session (own=false)

quiet.co_tenancy: STOP rather than measure anyway; never signal a holder

accuracy.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
accuracy.same_seed_only: A/A across clock arms: no transform changed, so no new float64 model reference is needed. A clock change must not move the structure; if it does, that is a finding and a STOP.
accuracy.conventions: the 512 bar and its 1.84 A user seed floor and the 298 bar with its own 0.741-0.847 A archived upstream seed pairs are each used only at their own size

kill: wrong opened node, containment change or boot change
foreign device holder or quiet/lock timeout
clock read error, a clock other than that fold's own target, or a coverage gap
FORCE_AICLK refused, or a requested clock that did not settle before the timer started
any structural deviation between clock arms over the size bar
foreign host CPU process at or above 20% of a core during an accepted fold
refutation: fitted F at or below 0 s: there is no clock-immune term and the two-parameter inverse-clock form is wrong
fitted F at or above the 298 aa fold time at 1350 MHz (9.680 s): a fixed cost larger than the whole smaller fold is not credible as a fixed cost
cell-median residual at an intermediate clock larger than max(A/A timing floor, 0.05 s): the fold is not T = F + C/f and F is not identified by this fit
any arm whose during-fold clock is not exactly its own requested target
bare: Production wheel, no Tracy/graph/observer/module timers/sum profiling, no trace, no hoist, no --fast, no MSA truncation, no tensor parallelism, no bfp8, no kernel change, no reduction of steps or recycles. Synchronize before the monotonic start and after predict_one including CIF writing: c10-bare-baseline's timer boundary, unchanged, because the comparison to 14.8813 s depends on it.
unmeasured: No device-cycle census, per-op budget, roof, ceiling, upstream accuracy or cross-run speedup. F is the term that does not scale with AICLK; it is NOT shown to be host CPU work, and it includes any device time bound by a clock domain AICLK does not drive.
